defect: UI accepted incomplete public records carrying only account/hash/confirmation markers. Actual renderer interpreted a missing successful flag as Failed and consumed absent amount/recipient/fee/block values. Older-page replies were not bound to the original inclusive cursor; nextCursor could point into displayed rows. Response arrays/objects were retained by reference and could change later displayed facts.
originalContract: Unchanged TransactionSubmissions.history validates original durable receipt, returns11 primitive public display fields, <=50 rows, and an inclusive nextCursor naming the first undisplayed transaction hash. It does not expose signed raw bytes or assert consensus finality. Main rechecks selected account after reading. Current supported receipt validator accepts successful local checkpoint receipts; UI boolean validation does not add a new failed-receipt producer or new network capability.
fix: Require exact own data fields without getters or extra/raw/sensitive fields, bounded canonical decimal display strings, non-self canonical recipient, original known RPC origin, explicit boolean successful and exact local-only confirmation markers; reuse original uint64 for positive block height. Detach and freeze each primitive row and published page. Older page must start at captured original cursor; next cursor cannot name a displayed hash or follow an empty page. On failure preserve original verified rows/cursor for explicit same-page retry. Refresh/account clear still retire late responses. No journal write, new transaction, receipt/signature policy, remote endpoint or permission change.
